reason: The executable is a self-mutating Rifaien submission agent with a truncated, obfuscated CLR resource loader appended. The recovered outer application does not establish unauthorized propagation; the missing embedded resource prevents a complete payload verdict. Do not put this unresolved composite into benign training data.

outer: Stock UPX 5.2.1 reports checksum error. Unicorn recovered only the decompressor and branch-repair output, stopping at VA 0x42871c before import resolution or application execution.

Rizin followed CRT startup at 0x401130 into main at 0x4013a0. Main reads the full file returned by GetModuleFileNameA, searches for [[UNIQUE]], seeds rand, chooses NODE1 through NODE7, and creates rifaien2-%s.exe.

The loop sleeps 30000 ms, overwrites sixteen bytes after the mutation marker, writes the complete self-image including overlay, and uses curl_formadd file[]/node/submit plus curl_easy_perform to submit it to http://wecan.hasthe.technology/upload. It deletes the clone and repeats.

No recovered outer-application path launches the appended PE, downloads executable code, reads credentials, spies on input, or establishes unauthorized remote control. Self-submission and an antivirus family label alone do not prove a worm.
overlay: A PE32 image begins at file offset 0x14c8b; the remaining 365705 bytes hash to 5350dc736d0b67b0d39ea24d57194d795d9f3614d7f994b252ccfa9587ed8991.
Rizin followed native main at 0x4019f0 through unrolled XOR string recovery, module enumeration, resource extraction, table-based block transformation and CLR COM hosting.

The 32-byte XOR decoder at 0x401650 recovers Cor_Enable_Profiling, mscorjit.dll, clrjit.dll, __, mscoree.dll and CLRCreateInstance from stack-built strings. Main dynamically resolves CLRCreateInstance and uses COM/SafeArray interfaces to load and invoke a managed assembly.

RCDATA resource __ declares 1937627 bytes at RVA 0x2613c; only 226125 bytes are available. RCDATA resource ~ declares 32 bytes at RVA 0x1ff218; none are available. It is read by the key/table initialization path. The missing bytes were not replaced with guessed data, and no payload was executed.

changes: Relocate Rifaien identity from well-known/malware/worm/snojan to well-known/dual-use/transfer/rifaien, rename the composite and remove the unsupported hostile worm claim and ATT&CK mapping. Preserve its matcher, size and platform scope.

Relocate the module-path/curl/form-field co-occurrence from objectives/exfiltration/http/upload to micro-behaviors/communications/http/upload. Name the reference co-occurrence precisely; remove the unsupported source-to-sink exfiltration claim and mapping. Preserve its conditions and exclusions.

Add a neutral x86 unrolled XOR-to-stack decoder trait. It recognizes the operation sequence with variable key bytes and displacements, including code in appended images; it does not identify a family or infer execution.

Fix cleave's PE and ELF UPX failure emitters: report a notable metadata/binary/layout/compression diagnostic. Corruption, unsupported formats, benign mutation and tool errors do not independently establish hostile evasion. Remove the classifier's obsolete indicts_image boolean.
Add a neutral CLR meta-host CLSID/IID pair observation, independent of encrypted API text and decoder keys; verify a one-GUID negative control.
